reviewed_by: Claude Code, PR 2a of the Butler home worker design at the operator's request
reason: Follows #1241 (merged). Behind NEBULA_BUTLER_HOME_WORKER (off), a Butler reservation for __nebula_butler__ makes the API create Butler's home project once and route the reservation there; the request carries focus.project and Butler keeps one home session per focus project. On the home worker the provider Butler gateway reads the focus project under observer_reads() and refuses changes; each home turn checks the focus project's local_only boundary; home sessions are provider-only; the new-project name scan skips reserved projects. Selected: the new home-session suite and PR 1's scope suite (creation race, name scan, reservation per focus, gateway observer reads, change and local-only refusal), Butler sessions and subagents (reservation changed), the API worker and global API (new pre-routing hook), execution-worker write locks (reservation under a worker scope), and the MCP context and provider tools-context suites (chat_components signature changed).
exclusions: tests/v3/test_butler_capabilities.py::test_scheduled_butler_can_edit_all_assistant_settings and tests/v3/test_settings_assistant_tools.py::test_provider_tools_are_bounded_to_catalog_and_project fail identically on unmodified origin/main 8fb8023 (after #1240), so those two files are not selected; their other cases passed locally with this change. No UI or operator-visible change: the flag is off and nothing in the UI reserves a home session yet, so frontend and Playwright selections are empty and LAN validation does not apply. PostgreSQL cases skip without NEBULA_TEST_POSTGRES_URL in CI; the selected suites passed locally on SQLite and the staging postgres:16 (nebula_pytest).
